name: doc_steering
task: Steer an in-flight document: create a doc, then revise a detail. Tests that echoecho routes the revision back into the same document (ideally resuming the same agent task via args.task_id) rather than refusing or spawning an unrelated file.
turns: draft a one paragraph team offsite announcement in offsite dot md, we're going to Lisbon in October
actually change Lisbon to Porto, keep everything else
success_criteria: offsite.md is created with a Lisbon announcement
after the correction, offsite.md says Porto and no longer says Lisbon
echoecho routes the edit to the existing document (same file), ideally reusing the earlier task via args.task_id
the read-back matches the final file content
red_flags: claims it cannot edit an existing document
creates a second, unrelated file for the correction
